note: Approved pixel areas for in-flight, unmerged changes only (ADR-0001 ruling, 2026-10-17): boxes approve PIXELS only, every DOM/string difference fails. This branch (inch-units, ADR-0001 F1c, on top of F1a): box = the desktop help pill #desktopHelp (F1a's approved '· ? for shortcuts'); scenes = the Edit sheet (#sheet) in edit-glyph and sheet-edit-object: the approved 'Dimensions · millimeters' header row with the mm | in switch (#dimsTitle + #unitSwitch) and the 'Position · millimeters' title (#posTitle). The switch row is taller than the old title, so everything below it in the sheet moves down; that is why the area is the whole sheet, as in the earlier --allow-box '#sheet' checks.
